messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
- As of 2026-02-19, the Boreal team consists of Lena only, after Marcus moved to Team Atlas. [valid 2026-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-19]
    earlier: As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-02-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- As of 2025-08-14, changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-08-14 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-14]
- The security audit flagged long-lived tokens on the auth gateway. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal decided the billing service will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-02-19, Lena has the Team Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2026-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-19-2]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-26, Marcus has the Team Boreal pager this cycle; pages for anything should go to Marcus, not Lena. [valid 2025-12-26 to 2026-02-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-26]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-31, Lena has the Team Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2025-10-31 to 2025-12-26; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-10-31]
- Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-21]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- As of 2026-01-22, Team Atlas decided that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
